info.title: TPT Pay API
info.description: Pre-release. Describes only the endpoints the core service serves. Stripe-compatible planned endpoints are listed in the compatibility report, not here.

bearerAuth.description: A secret (sk_) or publishable (pk_) API key.

prefix.description: The first characters of the key, for recognition. The key itself is never shown again.

last_used.description: Unix time the key was last used.

revoked.description: Unix time the key was revoked.

decline_code.description: If set, Authorize returns this card decline inside the window. Other calls fail with a network error.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A client-generated key that makes a write safe to retry. The same key with a different request is refused with 400. Keys expire after 24 hours.

get.description: Returns one page of the merchant's payment intents, newest first. Requires a secret key.

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: The id of the last intent on the previous page.

get.description: Any valid key. Only intents in the key's mode and merchant are visible.

post.summary: Attach a payment method and authorize
post.description: Any valid key, including publishable keys (browser checkout). For automatic capture the payment is captured and posted to the ledger.

502.description: The card network did not return a definitive result. The intent stays in processing; reconcile before retrying.

post.description: Requires a secret key and status requires_capture.
Requires a secret key. Not allowed once captured.
Requires a secret key and a succeeded payment intent. Omit amount to refund the remaining refundable balance. A refund reserves its amount while pending, so refunds cannot exceed what was captured.

payment_intent.description: ID of the payment intent to refund.

amount.description: Amount in minor units. Defaults to the remaining refundable balance.

200.description: The refund. A definitive network decline is returned here with status failed.

get.description: Returns one page of the merchant's refunds, newest first. Requires a secret key.

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: The id of the last refund on the previous page.

parameters.name: payment_intent
parameters.description: Only the refunds of this payment intent.

get.description: Any valid key. Only refunds in the key's mode and merchant are visible.
Returns one page of the merchant's webhook endpoints in the key's mode, newest first. Signing secrets are never returned. Requires a secret key.

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: The id of the last webhook endpoint on the previous page.

post.description: Requires a secret key. The signing secret is returned once.

url.description: https in live mode; http loopback allowed in test mode.

delete.description: Requires a secret key. The endpoint is disabled, not removed, so delivery history is kept.

get.description: Returns one page of the merchant's API keys in the key's mode, newest first. Revoked keys are included with their revocation time. Key secrets are never returned. Requires a secret key.

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: The id of the last API key on the previous page.

post.description: Requires a secret key. New keys are created in the caller's mode.

get.description: Returns one page of webhook deliveries for the merchant, newest first, with their status and attempt count. Requires a secret key.

post.description: Queues the same event (same event ID) for delivery again. Returns 202; the workers send it. Works for delivered and failed deliveries.

404.description: No such delivery in this merchant and mode

post.description: Shows what each merchant rule would do for a payment with this amount, currency and metadata, in the caller's mode. Nothing is created or recorded. A payment whose create call matches a blocking rule is refused with 402 and code payment_blocked.

amount.description: Amount in the currency's smallest unit.

200.description: The decision and one entry per rule

get.description: Returns the sandbox time and the scheduled outage windows. Test keys only (sk_test_...); live keys get 403. Sandbox only: the sandbox clock is per process and is not persisted.

200.description: The sandbox clock and its outage schedule

post.description: Give exactly one of seconds (1 to 31622400 per call) or frozen_time (not before the current sandbox time, and within 366 days of it). Test keys only (sk_test_...); live keys get 403. Sandbox only: the sandbox clock is per process and is not persisted.

200.description: The sandbox clock and its outage schedule

post.description: Adapter calls whose sandbox time falls in [from, to) fail. The end is exclusive. Test keys only (sk_test_...); live keys get 403. Sandbox only: the sandbox clock is per process and is not persisted.

200.description: The sandbox clock and its outage schedule

delete.description: Removes all scheduled windows. Test keys only (sk_test_...); live keys get 403. Sandbox only: the sandbox clock is per process and is not persisted.

200.description: The sandbox clock and its outage schedule
